dossier.purpose: Node/TypeScript CLI + MCP server (npm package `gitnexus`, branded 'GitNexus (Akon Labs)') that indexes a git repository with Tree-sitter plus its own heuristic scope-resolution pass into an embedded LadybugDB property graph. The graph holds symbols, CALLS/IMPORTS/EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS/ACCESSES edges with confidence scores, Leiden communities, execution flows, optional CFG/PDG/taint layers, and BM25 plus optional embedding search. It is stored in <repo>/.gitnexus/. The graph is exposed to agents through 17 MCP tools, resources and prompts (stdio or HTTP), a CLI that mirrors the tools, an Express HTTP API (`serve`) with a React web UI, and agent skills plus Claude Code/Codex/Cursor/Antigravity hook and plugin configs. Navigation answers come from this static symbol-level graph, not from language servers. The only file-editing MCP tool is a text-based `rename`.

claims.claim: Indexes any codebase into a knowledge graph (every dependency, call chain, cluster, execution flow) and exposes it through MCP tools 'so AI agents never miss code'.
Precomputes structure at index time (clustering, tracing, scoring) so tools return complete context in one call, instead of handing the LLM a raw graph to explore.

17 MCP tools (15 per-repo + 2 group): query (BM25+semantic+RRF), context ('360-degree symbol view - categorized refs, process participation'), impact, trace (shortest directed path between two symbols), detect_changes (maps changed lines to affected processes), check, rename, cypher, route_map, explain, pdg_query, and more.
rename = 'Multi-file coordinated rename with graph + text search'; the example output separates graph_edits (high confidence) from text_search_edits ('review carefully'); dry_run preview.
Parsing uses Tree-sitter ASTs; imports, calls, heritage, constructor inference and self/this receivers are resolved across files 'with language-aware logic'.

Supported-language table lists 16 languages (TS, JS, Python, Java, Kotlin, C#, Go, Rust, PHP, Ruby, Swift, C, C++, Objective-C, Dart, Zig); CFG/PDG (opt-in --pdg) is 'currently TypeScript & JavaScript'.

Claude Code and Codex get the deepest integration: MCP tools + agent skills + PreToolUse hooks that enrich searches with graph context + PostToolUse hooks that detect a stale index after commits and prompt the agent to reindex.
`analyze` indexes the codebase, installs agent skills, registers Claude Code hooks, and creates AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md context files; `setup` writes the MCP config.
CLI: 'everything runs locally on your machine. No network calls.' (comparison table: Privacy = 'Everything local, no network').
GITNEXUS_MCP_READ_ONLY=1 exposes only the single-repository read surface (raw cypher, rename and group tools omitted); any other value fails server startup.
Docker images (GHCR + Docker Hub, same digest) are signed with Cosign keyless signing and ship build-provenance and SBOM attestations; stable images only from vX.Y.Z tags matching the npm version.
Requirements: Node.js >= 22; a Git repository; Linux glibc 2.34+; on Windows, full-text search needs the VC++ redistributable plus OpenSSL 3.

Update notifier checks the npm registry 'latest' dist-tag at most once per 24h; skipped when CI is truthy, for npx/dev/Docker installs, or when GITNEXUS_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER / NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER is set.

PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0: free for non-commercial use, contact for commercial licensing; an enterprise SaaS / self-hosted offering exists and 'commercial use of the OSS version is also available with proper licensing'.

platforms.linux_x86_64: yes - primary CI target: full test suite on ubuntu-latest (.github/workflows/ci-tests.yml:16-19), vendored-grammar prebuild linux-x64 (.github/workflows/build-tree-sitter-prebuilds.yml:182), Docker image linux/amd64 (.github/workflows/docker.yml:216). Requires glibc >= 2.34 and Node ^22.18.0 || >=24.11.0 (gitnexus/README.md:465-468; gitnexus/package.json:133-135). musl/Alpine is not addressed (unknown).
platforms.wsl2: unknown - no upstream statement that the CLI/MCP server is supported on WSL2. Only incidental mentions: the dev container lists WSL2 hosts (.devcontainer/README.md:3), the eval workflow bench says native benchmark execution is 'Linux/WSL2-only' (eval/workflow_bench/README.md:138), and a code comment names WSL as a constrained environment (gitnexus/src/core/lbug/lbug-config.ts:230). WSL2 is a Linux userland, so the Linux glibc/Node requirements would apply.
platforms.macos_arm64: yes - darwin-arm64 grammar prebuilds are cross-built (.github/workflows/build-tree-sitter-prebuilds.yml:184); local embeddings are blocked only on darwin/x64 and the code points Intel users to Apple Silicon (gitnexus/src/core/embeddings/runtime-support.ts:53-69); Apple-Silicon 16 KiB page-size handling for LadybugDB (gitnexus/README.md:686); macOS build-tool note (gitnexus/README.md:640). CI runs only a ~50-file platform-sensitive subset on macos-latest; the full suite is Ubuntu-only (.github/workflows/ci-tests.yml:180-258; TESTING.md:85).
platforms.gpu: yes (optional, embeddings only; not required) - indexing, graph queries and all MCP tools are CPU-only. A GPU only accelerates opt-in local embeddings: device auto|dml|cuda|cpu|wasm (gitnexus/src/core/embeddings/config.ts:60-72), CUDA on Linux x64 and DirectML on Windows via onnxruntime-node (gitnexus/src/core/embeddings/onnxruntime-node-resolver.ts:36-37; gitnexus/src/core/embeddings/embedder.ts:108-110). Embeddings are off by default (README.md:446-447).

integrations.cli: Yes. `gitnexus` bin (gitnexus/package.json:30-32 -> dist/cli/index.js; source gitnexus/src/cli/index.ts:26-522): setup, uninstall, analyze [--watch|--pdg|--embeddings|--skills], index, serve, mcp, list, status, doctor, update, embeddings, clean, remove, wiki, augment, publish, eval-server, auto-sync, group, plus direct tool mirrors query/context/impact/trace/cypher/detect-changes/check (README.md:384-400; gitnexus/README.md:231-288). A `rename` CLI mirror is not listed.
integrations.mcp: Yes. `gitnexus mcp` serves MCP over stdio by default, or `--http` for a Streamable-HTTP/SSE server (default 127.0.0.1:3000; bearer token required for a non-loopback bind) (gitnexus/src/cli/index.ts:267-284; gitnexus/src/cli/mcp.ts:97-192; gitnexus/src/mcp/http-transport.ts:27-30). `gitnexus serve` also exposes /api/mcp (gitnexus/src/server/mcp-http.ts:32). 17 tools (gitnexus/src/mcp/tools.ts:91-986): list_repos, query, cypher, context, detect_changes, check, rename, impact, explain, pdg_query, route_map, tool_map, shape_check, api_impact, group_list, group_sync, trace; plus resources (gitnexus://...) and prompts detect_impact/generate_map (README.md:186-206). Only `rename` (and group_sync's contracts.json) writes files; no LSP-backed tool, no symbol-body edit/insert tool, no diagnostics tool. Source text is returned only via `context`/`query` with include_content=true, from text stored in the index at analyze time (gitnexus/src/mcp/local/local-backend.ts:4131-4152, 4860-4896).
integrations.sdk_or_api: No library SDK found: gitnexus/package.json declares only `bin` (no main/exports/types). HTTP API via `gitnexus serve` (Express, default bind 127.0.0.1:4747): /api/repos, /api/repo, /api/graph, /api/query, /api/search, /api/file, /api/grep, /api/processes, /api/clusters, /api/analyze, /api/embed, /api/mcp (gitnexus/src/server/api.ts:905-1680; gitnexus/src/cli/index.ts:260-265); `gitnexus eval-server` lightweight tool HTTP server (default 127.0.0.1:4848; non-loopback bind needs GITNEXUS_AUTH_TOKEN) (gitnexus/src/cli/index.ts:511-520; README.md:425-435).
integrations.claude_code_or_codex: Claude Code: (a) `gitnexus setup` (only if ~/.claude exists) writes the MCP entry to ~/.claude.json (gitnexus/src/cli/setup.ts:319-340), copies skills to ~/.claude/skills (setup.ts:345-358) and merges a PreToolUse hook (matcher Grep|Glob|Bash) and a PostToolUse hook (matcher Bash) into ~/.claude/settings.json (setup.ts:501-625); (b) manual `claude mcp add gitnexus -- npx -y gitnexus@latest mcp` (README.md:255); (c) a plugin directory gitnexus-claude-plugin/ (.claude-plugin/plugin.json, hooks/hooks.json, .mcp.json, 12 skills) listed by .claude-plugin/marketplace.json - README documents no install command for it; (d) `analyze` writes AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md sections and .claude/skills/gitnexus-* into the repo (gitnexus/src/cli/ai-context.ts:605-690). The hooks only append graph context to grep/glob/bash-search results and warn that the index is stale after git commit/merge/rebase/cherry-pick/pull (gitnexus/hooks/claude/gitnexus-hook.cjs:301-439). Native language-server navigation and post-edit diagnostics: none found (no LSP config or lspServers in gitnexus-claude-plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, no Edit/Write hook, no diagnostics tool). Codex: `codex mcp add gitnexus -- npx -y gitnexus@latest mcp` or ~/.codex/config.toml (README.md:261-273); hooks in ~/.codex/hooks.json installed by `gitnexus setup -c codex` (README.md:275; setup.ts:501-503); optional Codex plugin `codex plugin marketplace add abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus` (README.md:277-282; .agents/plugins/marketplace.json; gitnexus-claude-plugin/.codex-plugin/plugin.json); Codex skills go to ~/.agents/skills (gitnexus/src/cli/editor-targets.ts:177). README warns not to combine the plugin and `setup -c codex` (duplicate hooks) (README.md:284).

readme.telemetry_and_network: No analytics/telemetry client found in gitnexus/src (searched telemetry|analytics|sentry|posthog|mixpanel|amplitude|segment|plausible); 'telemetry' in code means local counters/logs, e.g. per-query timing logged to stderr at debug level (gitnexus/src/mcp/local/local-backend.ts:627-641). Outbound network that does exist: (1) Update notifier - GET <npm registry>/gitnexus/latest, cached 24h, also armed inside `gitnexus mcp` (gitnexus/src/core/update-check.ts:176-209; gitnexus/src/core/update-cache.ts:7-9; gitnexus/src/cli/mcp.ts:185,191); off for CI, npx/dev/Docker installs, or GITNEXUS_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER / NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER (update-cache.ts:29-36; gitnexus/README.md:496-528; Dockerfile.cli:123-126). (2) `analyze` by default INSTALLs missing LadybugDB FTS/VECTOR extensions over the network (extension.ladybugdb.com); GITNEXUS_LBUG_EXTENSION_INSTALL=load-only|never disables it; MCP/serve only LOAD (gitnexus/README.md:670-676; gitnexus/src/cli/doctor.ts:304-314). (3) Opt-in `--embeddings` downloads Snowflake/snowflake-arctic-embed-xs from huggingface.co (HF_ENDPOINT mirror) and onnxruntime-node's postinstall may fetch CUDA binaries from api.nuget.org (gitnexus/src/core/embeddings/embedder.ts:229-238; gitnexus/README.md:647-651); remote embeddings go to GITNEXUS_EMBEDDING_URL (gitnexus/README.md:362-388). (4) `wiki` sends graph/code context to an LLM endpoint; the code's default provider is MiniMax (https://api.minimax.io/v1, model MiniMax-M3), otherwise OpenRouter/OpenAI/Azure/local agent CLIs, with the key from env or ~/.gitnexus/config.json (gitnexus/src/core/wiki/llm-client.ts:99-165; README.md:855-859 states a different default model). (5) `auto-sync` clones/pulls over SSH from GitHub/GitLab/Gitee (README.md:517); `publish` sends a repository_dispatch only when UNDERSTAND_QUICKLY_TOKEN is set (README.md:636-638). (6) `@scarf/scarf` ^1.4.0 is a runtime dependency with an install script (gitnexus/package.json:62; gitnexus/package-lock.json:1740-1745) and is never imported in gitnexus/src; the project's own CI sets SCARF_ANALYTICS=false and DO_NOT_TRACK=1 when installing (.github/workflows/gitnexus-review-agent.yml:497-500). The package itself was not inspected (no node_modules in the clone). (7) Plugin and manual MCP configs launch `npx -y gitnexus@latest mcp` (gitnexus-claude-plugin/.mcp.json:3-7; README.md:255), so an npm fetch of the latest release happens at server start unless GitNexus is globally installed (README.md:71). No account is needed to index or use MCP tools; keys/accounts apply only to the optional wiki/embedding endpoints, Docker/Render/RepoCloud deploys and the commercial offering. The hosted web UI (gitnexus.vercel.app) is a static client whose AI chat is built on LangChain provider SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama; gitnexus-web/package.json:21-26), which implies requests to the chosen provider; this was not traced in detail.

code.architecture: Monorepo: gitnexus/ (npm package: CLI, MCP server, HTTP API, ingestion pipeline), gitnexus-web/ (Vite+React thin client over `serve`), gitnexus-shared/ (shared types), eval/ (Python benchmarks), and gitnexus-claude-plugin/, gitnexus-cursor-integration/, .claude/skills (static plugin/skill/hook configs) (ARCHITECTURE.md:3-14). Flow (ARCHITECTURE.md:16-27, 83-115): cli/analyze.ts -> core/run-analyze.ts -> core/ingestion/pipeline.ts runs a 19-phase DAG in core/ingestion/pipeline-phases/ (scan, structure, parse in a worker pool under core/ingestion/workers/, routes/tools/orm, crossFile, scopeResolution, mro, di, communities via Leiden, processes; --pdg adds taint/call-summary phases). Each of 18 languages has a LanguageProvider and ScopeResolver (core/ingestion/languages/, core/ingestion/scope-resolution/) with Tree-sitter queries and custom heuristic import/call/heritage resolution using confidence tiers 0.95/0.9/0.5 (ARCHITECTURE.md:420-424). Results are persisted by core/lbug/ into LadybugDB (@ladybugdb/core): node tables carry filePath/startLine/endLine/content (core/lbug/schema.ts:31-66) and a single CodeRelation edge table carries type, confidence, reason, step, staticGated and no source positions (schema.ts:683-692); registry at ~/.gitnexus/registry.json. Query layer: mcp/server.ts + mcp/tools.ts + mcp/local/local-backend.ts (stdio or HTTP), server/api.ts (Express), cli/tool.ts (direct CLI), core/search/ (BM25 FTS + optional vectors, RRF), core/embeddings/ (opt-in), core/wiki/ (LLM docs), core/group/ (cross-repo contracts), core/augmentation/engine.ts (used by hooks). The index is a snapshot keyed to lastCommit: `analyze` is incremental and `analyze --watch` refreshes from working-tree changes; MCP reopens a newly published index within ~5 s (README.md:402-422). There is no language-server component.
code.packaging_and_release: npm package `gitnexus` (gitnexus/package.json: files = dist, hooks, scripts, skills, vendor, web; prepack builds CLI + web UI and asserts grammar coverage, :56). The sole publisher is .github/workflows/publish.yml (header :3-16): RC mode on every push to main touching non-doc paths publishes npm `--tag rc` plus a GitHub prerelease and RC Docker images (also gitnexus/README.md:473-494); stable mode on a v<X.Y.Z> tag publishes `--tag latest` and creates a GitHub Release whose body comes from gitnexus/CHANGELOG.md (publish.yml:810-860). npm auth uses Trusted Publishing/OIDC with registry-attached provenance (publish.yml:285-289, 785-815). The GitHub Release has no uploaded assets or checksum files (publish.yml:833-860). Docker: Dockerfile.cli and Dockerfile.web are built by .github/workflows/docker.yml on v* tag push or workflow_call, linux/amd64+arm64, pushed to ghcr.io/abhigyanpatwari/{gitnexus,gitnexus-web} and docker.io/akonlabs/*, with the tag required to equal gitnexus/package.json's version (docker.yml:3-6, 113-135, 216), keyless Cosign signature per tag (docker.yml:235-250), actions/attest-build-provenance for both registries (docker.yml:257-271), and buildx provenance mode=max + sbom: true (.github/actions/docker-build-push-retry/action.yml:61-62, 86-87). A Kubernetes ClusterImagePolicy is provided (deploy/kubernetes/cluster-image-policy.yaml; README.md:1008-1023). 42 prebuilt Tree-sitter .node binaries (7 vendored grammars x 6 platform-arch) are cross-built by .github/workflows/build-tree-sitter-prebuilds.yml and committed to git (workflow header :3-53; .gitattributes:12). Third-party Actions are pinned by commit SHA. Deploy blueprints: render.yaml and a RepoCloud button (README.md:81-105). Stable cadence from the changelog: 1.6.11 on 2026-09-04, 1.6.12 on 2026-09-12 (gitnexus/CHANGELOG.md:7, 53).
code.tests_and_ci: Frameworks: Vitest 4 for gitnexus with three projects lbug-db / default / cli-e2e (gitnexus/vitest.config.ts:67,146,207; TESTING.md:58-68); Vitest+jsdom and Playwright for gitnexus-web (gitnexus-web/package.json:13-17); pytest for eval/ (eval/pyproject.toml:22-28); node:test for docker-server.test.mjs. Test-file count: ~1,070 in gitnexus/test (753 under test/unit, 317 under test/integration, plus 1 fixture spec), ~52 in gitnexus-web (11 Playwright specs in e2e/, 41 Vitest files), 30 pytest files in eval/tests, plus docker-server.test.mjs and .devcontainer/translate-plugin-registries.test.cjs. Coverage floors: statements 26 / branches 23 / functions 28 / lines 27, with `dangerouslyIgnoreUnhandledErrors: true` for LadybugDB N-API destructor issues (gitnexus/vitest.config.ts:24-25, 38-43). CI: 29 workflow files in .github/workflows/. ci.yml orchestrates ci-quality.yml (prettier --check, eslint, tsc --noEmit for gitnexus and gitnexus-web, workflow concurrency convention), ci-tests.yml (Ubuntu 3-shard full suite + merged coverage + web unit + docker-server test; windows-latest and macos-latest platform-sensitive subset in 3 shards each; Tree-sitter ABI gate on 3 OSes; packaged-install smoke on Windows and Ubuntu; Node 22.18 engines-floor import-link; GITNEXUS_BENCH scaling/fingerprint guards; eval pytest; Bubblewrap and Windows job-object containment tests) and ci-e2e.yml (Playwright chromium, only when gitnexus-web/ changes). Security workflows: codeql.yml (PR/push/weekly), dependency-review.yml (blocks high+), gitleaks.yml, scorecard.yml, trivy.yml, workflow-lint.yml (zizmor) (SECURITY.md:72-85). A husky pre-commit hook runs prettier + tsc only (TESTING.md:46-56). TESTING.md is partly stale: it cites `npm run test:parity` and ci-scope-parity.yml, neither of which exists (TESTING.md:25,117), and '373' test files (TESTING.md:85).

code.security_policy: SECURITY.md (repo root): supported = latest released minor on npm and the published Docker images, older minors not back-patched; private reporting via GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting; best-effort acknowledgement within 5 business days; scope and out-of-scope lists; hardening notes for Render deploys (token is the only control, /api/mcp auth) and /api/grep regex/ReDoS mitigations; table of automated CI scans (CodeQL, dependency-review, Gitleaks, Scorecard, zizmor, Trivy) (SECURITY.md:1-85).

claim_checks.claim: CLI: 'everything runs locally ... No network calls' (README.md:1101, 117)
claim_checks.evidence: The core index/query path is local (Tree-sitter, LadybugDB under .gitnexus/, MCP stdio), but code and the package README document outbound traffic: an npm-registry update check (gitnexus/src/core/update-check.ts:176-209, also armed in `gitnexus mcp`, gitnexus/src/cli/mcp.ts:185,191), a default network INSTALL of LadybugDB FTS/VECTOR extensions during analyze (gitnexus/README.md:670-676; gitnexus/src/cli/doctor.ts:304-314), the HuggingFace model download for opt-in embeddings (gitnexus/src/core/embeddings/embedder.ts:229-238) and LLM calls from `wiki` (gitnexus/src/core/wiki/llm-client.ts:134-142). Code over README: the 'No network calls' line overstates.

GITNEXUS_TOOLS in gitnexus/src/mcp/tools.ts:91-986 has 17 entries: list_repos, query, cypher, context, detect_changes, check, rename, impact, explain, pdg_query, route_map, tool_map, shape_check, api_impact, group_list, group_sync, trace. None is LSP-backed, and none edits symbol bodies.

claim_checks.claim: rename: 'Multi-file coordinated rename with graph + text search' (README.md:173)
claim_checks.evidence: It works as a textual rename. Candidate files are the symbol's own file, files of graph incoming refs (calls/imports/extends/implements), and files with a word-boundary hit from `rg` (execFileSync('rg'), 5 s timeout, fixed extension list). The apply step then does a whole-file global word-boundary regex replace on every such file (gitnexus/src/mcp/local/local-backend.ts:6071-6122, 6130-6171). It is not scope-aware: unrelated same-named identifiers, strings and comments in those files are rewritten, and the 'graph'/'text_search' confidence tag is per file, not per occurrence (:6134-6148). Preview is the default (tools.ts:459-463); the tool is annotated destructive (tools.ts:448). No language-server rename.

Returns symbol uid/name/kind/filePath/1-based startLine/endLine and optional `content` (only when include_content=true and retention is not 'none'; text comes from the index, not the live file) (gitnexus/src/mcp/local/local-backend.ts:4131-4152, 4860-4896). Incoming/outgoing refs are categorized lists of related symbols {uid,name,filePath,kind}, each direction limited to 30 rows (:4521-4531, 4677-4688, 4729-4743). The edge table has no call-site line/column (gitnexus/src/core/lbug/schema.ts:683-692). Results self-report incompleteness via epistemic/causes fields (gitnexus/src/mcp/tools.ts:295-306).

claim_checks.claim: Claude Code gets PreToolUse + PostToolUse hooks that enrich searches and detect a stale index after commits (README.md:233, 242)
claim_checks.evidence: gitnexus/hooks/claude/gitnexus-hook.cjs: PreToolUse handles Grep/Glob/Bash(rg|grep) by running `gitnexus augment -- <pattern>` and returning additionalContext (:301-367); PostToolUse handles only Bash commands matching git commit|merge|rebase|cherry-pick|pull and only emits an 'index is stale, run analyze' message (:389-439). Registered matchers are PreToolUse Grep|Glob|Bash and PostToolUse Bash (gitnexus/src/cli/setup.ts:576-607; gitnexus-claude-plugin/hooks/hooks.json:3-28). No Edit/Write hook and no diagnostics or type-check feedback.

gitnexus/src/cli/analyze.ts has no hook registration (its only 'registerHooks' hit is an unrelated Node API comment, :1140). `analyze` writes AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md sections and .claude/skills/gitnexus-* (gitnexus/src/cli/ai-context.ts:605-690). Claude Code hooks are written to ~/.claude/settings.json by `gitnexus setup` (gitnexus/src/cli/setup.ts:501-625) or ship with the plugin (gitnexus-claude-plugin/hooks/hooks.json). risks: Licensing: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (LICENSE:1; gitnexus/package.json:6) is a source-available license limited to non-commercial purposes. The project points commercial users to a separate license and an enterprise SaaS/self-hosted offering (README.md:1030-1045; gitnexus/README.md:897-901), and contributions are licensed under the same terms (CONTRIBUTING.md:5-7).

Scope vs language-server needs: there is no LSP client anywhere in the repo (the only language-server-tool names, tsserver/clangd/jdtls/pyright, appear in design comments at gitnexus/src/core/ingestion/scope-resolution/passes/receiver-bound-calls.ts:630-632 and languages/go/interface-impls.ts:1105). Definitions and references come from Tree-sitter plus a custom heuristic resolver (ARCHITECTURE.md:249-295). References are symbol-level and capped at 30 rows per direction in `context` (local-backend.ts:4530, 4686), edges carry no call-site position (schema.ts:683-692), and property-dispatch/callable targets are capped at 32, with overflow dropping the whole chain (gitnexus/README.md:805-853). Results flag `epistemic: lower-bound` when callers may be missing (tools.ts:295-306). Source text comes from the index snapshot, not the live file. The only file-editing MCP tool is `rename`, a whole-file regex replace (local-backend.ts:6130-6171). There are no symbol-body edit tools and no post-edit diagnostics; the Claude Code hooks fire only on Grep/Glob/Bash and git commands (gitnexus-hook.cjs:301-439).

Network, telemetry and supply chain: README.md:1101 says 'No network calls', but the code does an npm update check (update-check.ts:176-209), a default LadybugDB extension INSTALL during analyze (gitnexus/README.md:670-676), HuggingFace/NuGet downloads for embeddings (gitnexus/README.md:647-651) and LLM calls for `wiki` (llm-client.ts:134-142). `@scarf/scarf` is a runtime dependency with an install script, and the project's own CI disables it via SCARF_ANALYTICS=false (gitnexus/package.json:62; .github/workflows/gitnexus-review-agent.yml:499). Plugin and manual MCP configs run the unpinned `npx -y gitnexus@latest mcp` (gitnexus-claude-plugin/.mcp.json:3-7). 42 prebuilt native .node binaries are committed to git and shipped in the npm tarball (gitnexus/vendor/tree-sitter-*/prebuilds/**; package.json `files`).

Side effects on the repo and user config: `analyze` writes/updates AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, installs .claude/skills/gitnexus-* (and .agents/skills if .agents/ exists), and creates .gitnexus/ (gitnexus/src/cli/ai-context.ts:605-690; README.md:208-225) unless --skip-agents-md / --skip-skills / --index-only. `gitnexus setup` edits ~/.claude.json, ~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.claude/skills, ~/.codex/config.toml and hooks.json and other editors' configs (gitnexus/src/cli/setup.ts:319-358, 501-625; editor-targets.ts:156-178). `rename` with dry_run=false rewrites files in place (local-backend.ts:6160-6171).

Platform and runtime constraints: Node ^22.18.0 || >=24.11.0 (package.json:133-135); Linux needs glibc >= 2.34 (gitnexus/README.md:465-468); local embeddings are unavailable on macOS Intel (runtime-support.ts:53-69); Windows FTS needs the VC++ redistributable and OpenSSL 3 (gitnexus/README.md:469-471). Native addons @ladybugdb/core 0.18.3 and tree-sitter 0.21.1 are mandatory (package.json:60,87), and npm 11 `npx` can crash during install (README.md:63-69). LadybugDB is single-writer, so hook augmentation is skipped while an MCP/serve process holds the DB (gitnexus-hook.cjs:337-350). The full test suite runs only on Ubuntu; macOS and Windows run a ~50-file subset (TESTING.md:85; ci-tests.yml:180-258). WSL2 and musl are not addressed.

Release velocity and doc drift: v1.6.11 (2026-09-04) and v1.6.12 (2026-09-12) are 8 days apart (gitnexus/CHANGELOG.md:7, 53), and an RC is published to npm `rc` on every non-doc merge to main (publish.yml:8-13, 29-35). Docs lag code: TESTING.md cites a nonexistent ci-scope-parity.yml and `test:parity` (TESTING.md:25,117), language counts differ across docs (16/15/18/14), the roadmap lists incremental indexing as in progress although the changelog ships it (README.md:1063-1065), and the README's wiki default model differs from the code (README.md:857 vs llm-client.ts:29,150). Tests set dangerouslyIgnoreUnhandledErrors for LadybugDB N-API destructor issues, and coverage floors are 23-28% (vitest.config.ts:24-25, 38-43). CODEOWNERS lists three owners (.github/CODEOWNERS:3-5).

HTTP exposure of indexed source: `serve` defaults to 127.0.0.1:4747 (api.ts:905), but /api/mcp is unauthenticated unless GITNEXUS_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN is set, and a directly reachable serve exposes indexed source (SECURITY.md:62-63). On the Render blueprint the generated token is the only access control, and a token holder can read every indexed repo and index or delete repos (SECURITY.md:56-66; README.md:97-99). /api/grep runs caller-supplied regexes with a worker timeout (SECURITY.md:68-70). GITNEXUS_PUBLIC_ORIGIN 'currently refuses to start' (README.md:621). `gitnexus mcp --http` requires a bearer token only for non-loopback binds (gitnexus/src/cli/index.ts:282).

Provenance and release-artifact gaps: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json sets metadata.homepage to https://github.com/nicosxt/gitnexus with owner email nico@gitnexus.dev (lines 3-9), while the plugin manifests and package.json point to abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus; the README gives no Claude Code plugin install command (only the Codex plugin, README.md:280). The npm tarball is covered by npm provenance only (publish.yml:785-815), and GitHub Releases carry no assets or checksums (publish.yml:833-860). A comment says stable Docker builds are deferred (publish.yml:904-906) while docker.yml triggers on v* tags (docker.yml:3-6).
